음식은 사람을 이어주고
함께한 시간은 마음을 다시 데워준다는 걸
다시 배웠어요

흔들리는 순간 속에서도
우리는 서로를 통해 다시 웃을 수 있다는 것을...

en-US.title: Living in a foreign land, a reason to laugh together
en-US.description:
Living in a foreign country
sometimes means enduring unexpected moments.
2025 wasn't easy for me.
This year, I've had many moments where I've felt like I'm standing still and faltering.
I even fell into a trash can.

Yet, I was able to get back up and smile again
thanks to the warm love that was always there for me.

Through the kimchi I made with my mom a year ago,
and the time I spent with loved ones,
I learned again that food connects people,
and time spent together warms the heart.

It's okay if days aren't perfect,
and even in the midst of shaky moments,
we can smile again through each other...

I hope 2026 will be a year where our subscribers laugh more and warm moments last longer.

I will stay by your side
with a warm table and the small moments of everyday life.

Thank you.

en-US.title: The day before leaving, my 85-year-old mother's choice
en-US.description:
The day before leaving,
Mom started making kimchi again.

Despite her physical condition,
she said she felt at ease when she prepared a meal for her daughter.

This 85-year-old mother's stubborn love was evident.

She smiled over cabbages,
built memories while making kimchi together,
and promised to laugh again on the day she left.

This video
is a record of that day with Mom.

From kimchi-making to our farewell at the airport,
you can watch a longer story in the full video.

#USA #Daily #Immigrant life #Home cooking #Comfort #Green onion kimchi #Green onion pancake
Hello, this is Texas Hut

A bunch of green onions picked from my aunt's yard.
These days, it's scary to go grocery shopping, prices are going up endlessly,
and immigrant life...

It's much heavier than I thought

Today, I made green onion kimchi with green onions that smell like home

and made seafood pancake

This was a home cooking that made me pat myself on the back for eating well and living well

To our subscribers who had a hard week..
I hope this video today will be a warm corner of the hut where you can sit down and rest for a moment

Thank you for always coming..
and walking with us..
